slot_scores.name: unclear_production_time_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 110-hour weekly production time a fixed total available across both shifts, or is it a maximum limit that can be exceeded by adding overtime hours?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent probed the nature of the 110 hours (fixed vs. exceedable capacity) but never asked whether full utilization of 110 hours is a soft goal to be achieved and how it is prioritized relative to other objectives, so the goal-programming meaning of the slot was not fully covered.

slot_scores.name: unclear_overtime_limit_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the maximum number of overtime hours allowed per week, or is there no upper limit on overtime hours?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about the overtime limit but framed it purely as a value/maximum bound, never asking whether the 10-hour rule is a strict constraint or a soft prioritized goal, so the key meaning of the slot was not fully covered.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 110 hours is merely a regular-time capacity that may be freely split and left under-utilized, rather than a goal requiring full utilization at some priority.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent represented the 110 hours as an available capacity ('110 hours total available per week, split freely') and modeled it as ≤110, but never confirmed the goal/priority nature of fully utilizing the 110 hours.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 10-hour overtime rule is a hard upper bound (overtime hours curtain + overtime hours clothing ≤ 10).
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent modeled the overtime limit as a rigid constraint without ever confirming whether it is a strict bound or a soft prioritized goal.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent declared READY_TO_MODEL while both P0 hidden slots (H1 and H2) remained unresolved; it never clarified whether the 110-hour utilization and 10-hour overtime rule are soft, prioritized goals versus hard constraints.

summary: The agent gathered most data facts and constraints but did not surface the preemptive goal-programming structure behind the 110-hour utilization and 10-hour overtime rule, leaving both P0 slots only partially covered before stopping.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
